metadata.desc: Reverse image search across five engines — AnimeTrace, E-Hentai, Google Lens, Yandex, and SauceNAO. Results are rendered as polished card images, and an LLM tool for image search is provided.

enable_keyword_trigger.hint: When disabled, users can still search images via the LLM tool, but keywords such as '以图搜图' no longer trigger a search

allow_third_party_image_host.description: Allow uploading to third-party image hosts
allow_third_party_image_host.hint: Local image search on Google/Yandex requires uploading the image to a temporary image host first (tmpfiles/uguu/litterbox, etc.). When disabled, local image search is unavailable for these two engines and an image URL must be used instead

search_params_timeout.description: Time to wait for search parameters (engine name, image, etc.) in seconds
search_params_timeout.hint: Maximum time to wait for the engine name and image after the user sends the '以图搜图' command

keyword.hint: Configure the search trigger keyword and custom keywords for each search engine

trigger_keywords.description: List of keywords that trigger a search
trigger_keywords.hint: Image search is triggered when the user sends any one of these keywords; leave blank to use the default keyword

engine_keywords.description: Custom keywords (aliases) for each search engine
engine_keywords.hint: Configure a custom keyword for each search engine; users can use it to select the engine. Leave blank to use the default engine name

model.hint: Available models: anime_model_lovelive, pre_stable, anime, full_game_model_kira

is_multi.hint: Detect multiple characters in the image

ai_detect.hint: Detect whether the image is AI-generated

is_ex.hint: Requires an ExHentai account and a valid Cookie

cookies.hint: How to get it: log in to e-hentai.org (exhentai.org for ExHentai), press F12 → Console tab → type document.cookie and press Enter → copy the whole output line (including ipb_member_id/ipb_pass_hash/igneous). Can be left blank if you only search E-Hentai; required for ExHentai

serpapi_key.hint: Optional (recommended). Apply at https://serpapi.com/. Implemented via Google Lens.

zenserp_key.hint: Optional (fallback). Apply at https://zenserp.com/. Implemented via Google Reverse Image.

hl.hint: Google interface language code (e.g. zh-CN, en, ja)

country.hint: Country/region code for search results (e.g. cn, us, jp)

max_results.hint: Maximum number of results returned by the API (note: SerpApi/Zenserp pagination may consume quota)

api_key.hint: Used to access the SauceNAO API. A free account is limited to 150 requests per day and 4 per 30 seconds

cookies.hint: How to get it: log in to yandex.com/images, press F12 → Console tab → type document.cookie and press Enter to copy (if HttpOnly fields are missing, use: F12 → Network tab (keep the filter box empty!) → refresh → click the first request → Headers → copy the entire Cookie request-header line). Leaving it blank may trigger a CAPTCHA and produce no results
